candidate_evidence.quote: TAS2940 is a small molecule inhibitor of ERBB family proteins HER2 and EGFR. It has not been evaluated in human subjects yet.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Cohort C: Recurrent or refractory glioblastoma
Have histologically confirmed solid cancer that is locally advanced and metastatic and available standard treatment options have been exhausted

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Evaluation of the maximum observed plasma concentration; time to reach maximum concentration, area under the Concentration-time curve and time it takes for plasma concentration to fall by half its original value (T1/2) of TAS2940

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: to assess the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and the preliminary antitumor activity of TAS2940

role_evidence.quote: Study participants with solid tumors and EGFR or HER2 aberrations will receive TAS2940 tablets daily at increasing doses until MTD is reached.

coder_notes: Basket trial; glioblastoma named in conditions, eligibility (Cohort C) and arm label 'Dose Expansion Gliblastoma' (typo in record). The official title restricts the whole study to tumours with EGFR and/or HER2 aberrations; the GBM cohort criterion itself ('Recurrent or refractory glioblastoma') does not restate the EGFR/HER2 requirement, but the GBM arm description says 'select solid tumors characterized by HER2 or EGFR aberrations'. Coded eligibility (whole trial); could alternatively be enrichment, which does not change the primary outcome. HER2-positive breast cancer cohort B is an additional HER2 enrichment. Target engagement coded yes from the stated pharmacodynamic objective; no specific PD measure or sample is described.
